Hamstr 0.7.6 fixes cover proportions, playback handover and unnecessary link-resolution work.

- Your devices now show the saved phone/computer type as an icon on the left. Laptops and desktop PCs still share the existing Computer type.
- Playlist cover stacks use proportional corner radii and borders, and larger covers in the playlist picker, instead of small nearly circular pictures.
- Audio previews, imported audio tiles and audio-playlist tiles use square covers. Known music sources start playlist imports in Audio mode; flat video playlists are not mistaken for audio just because they omit formats.
- Hamstr's automatic return after another app stops is limited to positively identified video interruptions. Music, podcasts and unknown audio leave Hamstr paused until playback is explicitly restarted.
- Known YouTube links skip generic extractor matching. Python warmup no longer sweeps every extractor URL pattern, and instant Cheek downloads avoid a duplicate preliminary file probe.
- Desktop Glyph and direct-media links try Cheek first, retaining yt-dlp fallback for other or misleading links.
- Bundles cheek 0.3.1 with fewer repeated HTTP requests, pooled connections and separate phase timings.

r-dlp is not integrated. YouTube Music latency and cross-app audio behavior still need physical Android verification. Desktop installers are not signed yet. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
